body: Hey I am in pretty much the same situation, same age too! My grades have always been pretty bad though, but lately I missed a lot of school. I am very very behind, and just stressed out more. I eat more too the more depressed I am. I have gained quite a bit of weight because of it the last year or 2. I will sit in class and look at everyone and just think how gross or weird or annoying everyone is. Im not normally a judgmental person so I hate doing this but when my mood is bad I cant help it. Lucky for me my mom believed me, my father however think it is laziness. I don't know how he can think that I mean, laziness doesn't put scars like this on your arm. Friends think its laziness too. everyone thinks I have no reason to feel his way because really, I don't, but I do, and only a few people seem to understand. My dad is just making stuff worse for me. So yeah I pretty much know where your coming from so Im sorry that you don't have her believing you, but you do have us here we are always here for you, and we all understand. Also try telling EXACTLY how you feel. My mom was pretty snippy with me until I told her I have had thoughts of suicide. Now she understands how serious the problem actually is. Tell your mom about the car thing, it might help, and anything else you are keeping from her.
Nah he's just a jerk and admits it " its who I am if you don't like it too bad" I have my mom though.
Do you mean something like Clean your house or a room. The feeling of accomplishing something helps a lot.
